study: eBOSS DR16 LRG×ELG A-03 selection/window provenance decision and acceptance criteria after successfully archived A-02 18/18 galaxy cross-LS code transport
registration_timing: Before any new observed-galaxy or odd-vector read, any new science veto, any extrapolation of four image samples to the entire ELG mask, or any physical-mask/window certification.

primary_published_reference.scope: Raichoor et al. DR16 ELG LSS, Sec 3.1/3.2/Table 5/Data Availability: mask bits1–7 from brickmask tag v1.0; custom Python bits8–11 and two non-bitcoded bad eboss22 plates available on request.

existing_selection_source_evidence.later_public_README_credit: README acknowledges Arnaud de Mattia shared original extra maskbit eBOSS ELG script with public brickmask author. This is a lead for source request, not proof later helper is DR16 production original.

required_return: Exact raw supplemental Python/configuration/source used for DR16 bits8–11 (not only a later helper), original release/version/commit/date and published catalogue versions
Exact 37-pixel bit8 coordinate convention/HEALPix settings actually run and direct released VETOMASK/bit8 mapping with stage/order
Exact three polygon inputs, overlap/boundary logic and priority/acceptance for bits9–11
Exact geometry, two PLATE-MJD source identifiers, any priority/overlap and input/output release application for non-bitcoded eboss22 bad plates
Independent original DATA and RANDOM invocations/outputs including chunk, imaging depth and shuffled-z assignment where relevant
Provenance/file version and source byte identities or attributable source reference
historical_source_request.intake_guard: On receipt first archive untouched bytes, attribution, original URL/message ID and full SHA256 with a new prospectively registered source-only check; never immediately run on published data/randoms or tune against observed odd.

historical_full_mask_reconstruction.can_certify_only_if: Attributable exact historical production source/invocation, released DATA and RANDOM acceptance geometry/version, original raw source fingerprints, independent reproduction and documented exclusions/overlaps. Public 2023 helper plus 15/15 label match and four sample pixels are insufficient.
historical_full_mask_reconstruction.forbidden_fallback: Do not fabricate full sky mask, plate circular radius, effective LRG∩ELG hard mask or vintage executable.

published_random_empirical_pair_window.scope: The released, independently SHA-pinned LRG and ELG tracer-specific randoms and cross R_L R_E pair counts can define an empirical, finite-catalogue pair window under the published selection, with explicit completeness/depth-conditioned radial and redshift-shuffle effects.
published_random_empirical_pair_window.minimum_future_validation: An independently preregistered blind random-galaxy injection/recovery and selection-systematics model with correct cap/chunk/depth conditionality, finite-random noise, null controls and quantified uncertainty; no claim of continuous exact physical hard-mask geometry if source unrecovered.
published_random_empirical_pair_window.cannot_claim: Historical mask execution reproduced, all ELG brick pixels certified, or empirical random window alone implies physical odd null/covariance.

next_bounded_action: Source-only regression audit of this decision, update and hold author-source draft pending explicit user approval to send, and prepare A-04 finite resource/coverage plan WITHOUT new mock downloads or observed analysis.
